parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, typically made of metal for strength and flexibility. It is a long, thin component extending from the frame to rest over the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the wearer’s head by resting on the ear, providing stability and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It balances the eyeglasses on the opposite side of the head, ensuring even weight distribution and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint attached to the base body, folding inward for compact storage.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the eyeglasses, including the lens rims and bridge, typically made of plastic for lightweight comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the structural connection between the two legs. It also rests on the nose via the bridge.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support structure for the entire eyeglass assembly.
